links.outcome: Expert-rated correctness and safety of fine-tuned myopia education LLM versus general LLMs on standardised scenarios
links.effect: MiKid-QA scored higher on correctness (4.43±0.63) and safety (4.38±0.59) than DeepSeek and GPT-4 (all p<0.001); completeness and helpfulness comparable (p>0.05).
links.quote: In expert evaluations, MiKid-QA achieved significantly higher scores for correctness (4.43±0.63) and safety (4.38±0.59) compared with DeepSeek and GPT-4 (all p<0.001).

unlisted_practices: Domain-specific fine-tuning (LoRA) on curated professional datasets to improve correctness and safety of patient-education LLM

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates a fine-tuned LLM (MiKid-QA) for pediatric myopia education against general-purpose LLMs across expert-rated clinical vignettes, without evaluating specific deployment guardrails or implementation practices.
